20261118-math-g03.material: [E3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta] Su'aasha baaritaanka ee ku saabsan Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin, jajabyo, cabbir, shaxyo, xog. Laba lambar oo dabiici ah $A$ iyo $B$ waxay buuxinayaan $A + 2B = 24$. Marka $A$ qaato qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee suurtogalka ah, waa imisa qiimaha $B$?
20261118-math-g03.thinking.0: Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin, jajabyo, cabbir, shaxyo, xog
20261118-math-g03.s.s1.prompt: [E3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta] Su'aasha baaritaanka ee ku saabsan Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin, jajabyo, cabbir, shaxyo, xog. Laba lambar oo dabiici ah $A$ iyo $B$ waxay buuxinayaan $A + 2B = 24$. Marka $A$ qaato qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee suurtogalka ah, waa imisa qiimaha $B$?
20261118-math-g03.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Dib u habaynta isla'egtu waxay bixinaysaa $A = 24 - 2B$.
Tallaabada 2: Maadaama $A, B \ge 1$ ay yihiin lambarro dabiici ah, $2B$ waa inuu noqdaa kan ugu yar si $A$ u weynaado.
Tallaabada 3: Lambarka dabiiciga ah ee ugu yar waa $B = 1$.
Tallaabada 4: Meeshan, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (ugu sarreeya), markaa $B = 1$.

20261118-math-g03.s.s1.hint.1: Maadaama $A = 24 - 2B$, $A$ wuxuu noqonayaa mid weyn marka $B$ uu yar yahay.

20261121-math-g03-1.material: [E3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta (Sare)] Dhibaatada baaritaanka adag iyadoo la adeegsanayo Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin, jajabyo, cabbir, shaxyo, xog. Wadarta saddex lambar oo dabiici ah oo isxiga waa $3S$, taranka kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn oo lagu daray $1$ wuxuu le'eg yahay $T^2$. Marka $S = 15$, keebaa ugu weyn saddexdan?
20261121-math-g03-1.thinking.0: Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin, jajabyo, cabbir, shaxyo, xog
20261121-math-g03-1.s.s1.prompt: [E3 Baaritaanka Xisaabta (Sare)] Dhibaatada baaritaanka adag iyadoo la adeegsanayo Isku-dhufasho iyo qaybin, jajabyo, cabbir, shaxyo, xog. Wadarta saddex lambar oo dabiici ah oo isxiga waa $3S$, taranka kan ugu yar iyo kan ugu weyn oo lagu daray $1$ wuxuu le'eg yahay $T^2$. Marka $S = 15$, keebaa ugu weyn saddexdan?
20261121-math-g03-1.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabada 1: Isagoo lambarrada loo qaadanayo $n-1, n, n+1$, wadartu waa $3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Tallaabada 2: Saddexda lambar waa $14, 15, 16$.
Tallaabada 3: Lambarka ugu weyn waa $16$.
Tallaabada 4: Xaqiijin: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.
